tug_why1: Soft fleece is gentle on teeth and gums during supervised tug play, with a cushioned grip for dogs that pull hard.
tug_why2: No heavy knots and no plastic parts, so play stays quiet and kind to your floors.
tug_why3: Machine washable on a sensitive programme at 30 degrees.
tug_nala_text: Nala, our ambassador, tested the tug in many play sessions. Tug is a great reward in training: play a short round, then put the tug away so it stays special.
tug_d_sizes: Small about 30-35 cm, Medium about 35-45 cm, Large about 45-55 cm. Lengths are indicative.
tug_d_dispatch: Packed by hand and sent within 5 days of your order by tracked post. Every parcel includes a handmade thank-you card.
tug_d_returns: You can withdraw from the purchase within 14 days of delivery.
tug_safe1: For supervised tug play only. This is not a chew toy.
tug_safe2: Put the tug away after play, out of your dog's reach.
tug_safe3: Check the tug before each use. Replace it if it is worn or torn, or if pieces come loose.
tug_safe4: If your dog swallows fleece, contact your vet.
tug_safe5: This is a dog toy, not a toy for children.
